response.headline: Stable day 2 cellulitis patient; all vitals within plan, NEWS2 0 now.

summary_points.text: Anders Berg, 81 M, left lower leg cellulitis on IV cloxacillin via portable pump, day 2 of virtual-ward stay.
NEWS2 is 0 at 09:00 with no active queue flags.
Last six hours of good readings show NEWS2 of 0 apart from 1 at 04:00.
Home visit on 2026-11-20 recorded vitals within plan, patient comfortable, eating and drinking, no new concerns.
Patient messaged that the pump is beeping and asked whether this is normal; no reply is recorded.

plan_rules.rule: NEWS2 urgent threshold 5 or any single parameter scoring 3

relevant_history.text: Comorbidities include type 2 diabetes and venous insufficiency; lives with wife as caregiver, not alone.

suggested_actions.action: Consider contacting the patient to answer the pump beeping question and confirm the pump is running correctly.
suggested_actions.rationale: Patient asked on 2026-11-20 at 18:00 and no reply is recorded.

suggested_actions.action: Consider confirming the IV line and pump are functioning at the next visit.
